You visited a travel website for international tourists and found this notice written
by a British author about an event in your city.
Night Market
Experience the sights, sounds, and tastes of our city at the Night Market
in East Park, held once a month during the summer.
Enjoy an evening walk
out of the midday heat while you view the fruits and vegetables our area has to
offer.
You can also see art, clothing, speciality foods, and other beautiful items
made by local people.
With special events arranged by local organisations
every night, the Night Market
is also the perfect place to find out about local
hot spots and entertainment.
